title: Reading an ECG decision chart: in the same order every time, check rate, rhythm, intervals, axis, hypertrophy and ischemia or infarction; each step gives how to measure it, the normal range and where an abnormal result sends you next

root.title: Reading an electrocardiogram (ECG): the SAME ORDER every time
lines: depolarization moving TOWARD a positive electrode writes an UPWARD deflection: leads, axis and infarct location all follow from that
paper: 1 small box = 40 ms · 1 large box = 200 ms · 10 mm = 1 mV
